// widget that must defer initialisation until consent is established (Google
// Publisher Tag: Init, Google Tag Manager: Init, etc).
function onConsentReady(callback, fallbackMs) {
    var called = false;
    function fire() {
        if (called) return;
        called = true;
        callback();
    }

    if (window.OneTrust?.IsAlertBoxClosed?.()) {
        fire();
        return;
    }

    if (window.OneTrust?.OnConsentChanged) {
        window.OneTrust.OnConsentChanged(fire);
    }

    document.addEventListener('onetrustLoaded', fire, { once: true });

    if (typeof fallbackMs === 'number') {
        setTimeout(fire, fallbackMs);
    }
}

<script>
(function () {
    const MINUTELY_SCRIPT_SRC = '//apv-launcher.minute-ly.com/api/launcher/MIN-903070.js';
    const MINUTELY_CONSENT_GROUP = 'C0004'; // targeting/advertising

    function hasConsent() {
        return Boolean(window.OnetrustActiveGroups?.includes(MINUTELY_CONSENT_GROUP));
    }

    function consentDecided() {
        return Boolean(window.OneTrust?.IsAlertBoxClosed?.());
    }

    function injectScript() {
        if (document.querySelector('script[src="' + MINUTELY_SCRIPT_SRC + '"]')) {
            return;
        }
        const script = document.createElement('script');
        script.src = MINUTELY_SCRIPT_SRC;
        script.async = true;
        document.head.appendChild(script);
    }

    // Gated on OneTrust consent for the targeting/advertising category (C0004):
    // loads immediately if consent is already granted, never loads if it's
    // already been declined, and otherwise waits for the user's consent
    // decision before acting on it.
    function checkConsentAndLoad() {
        if (hasConsent()) {
            console.info('[Minutely] Consent already granted, loading script');
            injectScript();
        } else if (consentDecided()) {
            console.info('[Minutely] Consent already declined, not loading script');
        } else if (window.OneTrust?.OnConsentChanged) {
            console.info('[Minutely] Consent not yet decided, waiting for OnConsentChanged');
            window.OneTrust.OnConsentChanged((event) => {
                if (event?.detail?.includes(MINUTELY_CONSENT_GROUP)) {
                    console.info('[Minutely] Consent granted via OnConsentChanged, loading script');
                    injectScript();
                } else {
                    console.info('[Minutely] Consent declined via OnConsentChanged, not loading script');
                }
            });
        } else {
            console.info('[Minutely] OneTrust not yet loaded, waiting for onetrustLoaded');
            document.addEventListener('onetrustLoaded', checkConsentAndLoad, { once: true });
        }
    }

    checkConsentAndLoad();
})();
</script>
